## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION: The Project Support Administration (PSA) position is part of the Comparator Client Services Team.

As an PSA, you play a valuable role in managing independently the entire range of administrative tasks of a client portfolio assigned to you as per the job responsibilities. Key to success in this role is the ability to independently interact with the internal stakeholders. Working closely together with the client facing Project Manager, the Sourcing Specialists & the Supply Chain Coordination Team members, you ensure that the services are delivered on time and to customer's and Fisher's quality standards.

You act as point of contact for internal customers, supporting the client facing Project Manager to select the appropriate sourcing strategy based on customers constraints, providing timely and accurate communication and information for all relevant activities related to comparator projects, internally. This is to ensure that the products are ready for the start of the clinical trial study or as required by the customer. REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
• Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
• Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
• Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
• Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
• Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
• Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
• Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
• Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail
• Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Come PSA, si gioca un ruolo prezioso nella gestione indipendentemente l'intera gamma di compiti amministrativi di un portafoglio clienti assegnato a voi come per le responsabilità del lavoro. La chiave del successo in questo ruolo è la capacità di interagire in modo indipendente con gli stakeholder interni. L'utente agisce come punto di contatto per i clienti interni, supportando il cliente che affronta Project Manager per selezionare l'appropriata strategia di approvvigionamento basata sui vincoli dei clienti, fornendo comunicazioni e informazioni tempestive e accurate per tutte le attività rilevanti relative ai progetti di comparatore, internamente. Questo è quello di garantire che i prodotti sono pronti per l'inizio dello studio clinico o come richiesto dal cliente. PRESCRIZIONI:
• Corso di laurea richiesto, nessuna esperienza preventiva richiesta, preferibilmente in studi clinici o industria farmaceutica
• Preferiti Campi di studio: sanità, gestione della supply chain, scienze della vita o campo correlato
• Certificazione di gestione del progetto da istituzione riconosciuta benefica
• Forte comprensione dei principi GMP/GxP e dei sistemi di gestione della qualità
• Dimostrate capacità di gestione del progetto con capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente
• Proficienza avanzata nella suite Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel e Project
• Esperienza con sistemi aziendali come Salesforce, GPMS e TrackWise preferiti
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving
• Efficace capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale
• Dettaglio orientato con eccellenti capacità organizzative e documentali
• Capacità dimostrata di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di team interfunzionali
• Inglese fluente richiesto, lingue aggiuntive benefiche
• Esperienza coordinata con i team e gestione delle relazioni con gli stakeholder
• Capacità di analizzare i dati e generare report chiari e precisi
• Focus sul servizio di qualità e miglioramento continuo
• Adattabile al cambiamento delle priorità, mantenendo l'attenzione ai dettagli
• I viaggi nei siti dei clienti o in altre strutture possono essere richiesti

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die erforderlich sind, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs. Die Position Project Support Administration (PSA) ist Teil des Comparator Client Services Teams.

Als PSA spielen Sie eine wertvolle Rolle bei der unabhängigen Verwaltung des gesamten Spektrums der administrativen Aufgaben eines Kundenportfolios, das Ihnen gemäß den Aufgaben zugewiesen wurde. Der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle ist die Fähigkeit, unabhängig mit den internen Stakeholdern zu interagieren. Sie fungieren als Ansprechpartner für interne Kunden und unterstützen den Kunden, der sich dem Projektmanager gegenübersieht, um die geeignete Sourcing-Strategie basierend auf Kundenbeschränkungen auszuwählen, und bieten zeitnahe und genaue Kommunikation und Informationen für alle relevanten Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Vergleichsprojekten intern. Damit soll sichergestellt werden, dass die Produkte für den Beginn der klinischen Studie bereit sind oder vom Kunden verlangt werden. ANFORDERUNGEN:

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer. DESCRIPTION : Le poste d'Administration du soutien de projet (ASP) fait partie de l'équipe des services à la clientèle de comparaison.

En tant que PSA, vous jouez un rôle précieux dans la gestion indépendante de l'ensemble des tâches administratives d'un portefeuille client qui vous sont assignées selon les responsabilités d'emploi. La clé du succès dans ce rôle est la capacité d'interagir de façon indépendante avec les intervenants internes. Vous agissez comme point de contact pour les clients internes, aidant le client confronté au gestionnaire de projet à choisir la stratégie d'approvisionnement appropriée en fonction des contraintes des clients, fournissant des communications et des informations opportunes et précises pour toutes les activités pertinentes liées aux projets de comparaison, à l'interne. Il s'agit de s'assurer que les produits sont prêts pour le début de l'étude clinique ou comme l'exige le client. EXIGENCES:

• Expérience avec des systèmes d'entreprise comme Salesforce, GPMS et TrackWise préférés
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Compétences efficaces en communication écrite et verbale
• Orientation détaillée avec d'excellentes capacités organisationnelles et documentaires

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

Positionsübersicht: Der Senior Quality Control Technician (m/w/d) sorgt für die Einhaltung höchster Qualitätsstandards in der pharmazeutischen Produktionsumgebung. Diese Position umfasst eine Vielzahl von Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit der Inspektion, Überwachung und Dokumentation von Prozessen und Materialien und gewährleistet die Einhaltung der GMP-Standards.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

- Start-Up Freigabe: Vorbereitung von Raum, Maschinen und Materialien vor dem Produktionsstart.

- In-Prozess-Kontrollen: Durchführung von regelmässigen In-Prozess-Kontrollen, um die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu gewährleisten.

- Endkontrollen: Durchführung von Abschlussinspektionen der verpackten Studienmedikation (Blindkontrolle).

- Qualitätsentscheidungen: Treffen von Qualitätsentscheidungen in den jeweiligen Arbeitsbereichen/Kabinen.

- Vorbeugung von Abweichungen: Implementierung von Massnahmen zur Vermeidung von Prozessabweichungen.

- Abweichungsmanagement: Initiieren von Abweichungsberichten in Global Trackwise.

- Mikrobiologische Überwachung: Durchführung von mikrobiologischen Messungen, um eine sterile Umgebung zu gewährleisten.

- Materialverwaltung: Verwalten der Quarantäne und Freigabe von Materialien im Betrieb.

- Inspektionsrundgänge: Führung von wöchentlichen Inspektionsgängen in den Produktionsbereichen durch.

- Überwachung der Maschinen: Unterstützung und Durchführung der Geräteüberwachung und -kalibrierung.

- Dokumentation: Erstellung von Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) und Formularen im elektronischen Dokumentenmanagementsystem (eDMS).

- Environmental-Monitoring: Überprüfung von wöchentlichen und monatlichen Temperatur- und Luftfeuchtigkeitsmesswerte.

- Lichtmessungen: Führung nach Bedarf Lichtmessungen durch.

- Support-Anfragen: Bearbeitung und Unterstützung bei Internen- und Kundenanfragen.

- Logbuch-Verwaltung: Kontrollen und Archivierung von Logbüchern.

- Meldung von Problemen: Informationen direkten Vorgesetzten über alle aufgetretenen Probleme.

- Schulungsbedarf: Ermittlung des persönlichen Schulungsbedarfs und Unterstützung der Schulung neuer Mitarbeiter am Arbeitsplatz.

Qualifikationen:

- Erfahrung im Bereich pharmazeutischen Herstellung und/oder in Qualitätskontrolle.

- Kenntnisse der Guten Herstellungspraxis (GMP).

- Hohes Mass an Genauigkeit und Effizienz.

- Ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit.

- Fähigkeit, im Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten (06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00).

- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch zum Vorteil

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Word und Excel.

Zusätzliche Informationen: Diese Stellenbeschreibung umfasst nicht alle Aufgaben und Zuständigkeiten, die für diese Funktion erforderlich sind. Alle zusätzlichen Pflichten, Aufgaben oder Verantwortlichkeiten, die vom Teamleiter oder Manager verlangt werden, müssen entsprechend ausgeführt werden.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören!

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza, cleanroom: no prodotti per capelli, gioielli, trucco, smalto per unghie, profumo, piercing a vista, capelli facciali ecc... consentiti, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, un certo grado di PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) richiesto (vetri di sicurezza, abiti, guanti, camice da laboratorio, spine per orecchie ecc.)

## Descrizione del lavoro

Riepilogo della posizione: Il tecnico senior Quality Control (m/f/d) garantisce il rispetto dei più elevati standard di qualità nell'ambiente di produzione farmaceutica. Questa posizione copre una serie di compiti relativi all'ispezione, al monitoraggio e alla documentazione dei processi e dei materiali e garantisce il rispetto degli standard GMP.

Principali responsabilità:

- Avvio: Preparazione di spazi, macchine e materiali prima dell'inizio della produzione.

- Controlli in-processo: eseguire controlli regolari in-process per garantire la conformità.

- Controlli finali: condurre ispezioni finali di farmaci di studio confezionati (controllo cieco).

- Decisioni di qualità: prendere decisioni di qualità nelle rispettive aree di lavoro / cabine.

- Prevenzione delle deviazioni: attuazione di misure per evitare deviazioni di processo.

- Gestione della Deviazione: Avviare i Rapporti della Deviazione in senso globale.

- Monitoraggio microbiologico: eseguire misurazioni microbiologiche per garantire un ambiente sterile.

- Gestione dei materiali: gestione della quarantena e rilascio dei materiali nell'operazione.

- Visite di ispezione: condurre tour di ispezione settimanali nelle aree di produzione.

- Monitoraggio del macchinario: supporto e implementazione del monitoraggio e della calibrazione delle apparecchiature.

- Documentazione: Creazione di procedure operative standard (SOP) e forme nel sistema di gestione dei documenti elettronici (eDMS).

- Monitoraggio ambientale: revisione delle letture settimanali e mensili di temperatura e umidità.

- Misure di luce: condurre misurazioni della luce come richiesto.

- Richieste di supporto: Elaborazione e supporto per le richieste interne e dei clienti.

- Gestione dei registri: controlli e archiviazione dei registri.

- Problemi di segnalazione: supervisori diretti delle informazioni su tutti i problemi che si sono verificati.

- Le esigenze di formazione: individuare le esigenze di formazione personale e sostenere la formazione di nuovi dipendenti sul posto di lavoro.

Qualifiche:

- Esperienza nella produzione farmaceutica e/o nel controllo della qualità.

- Conoscenza della buona prassi manifatturiera (GMP).

- Alto grado di precisione ed efficienza.

- Forte senso di responsabilità e affidabilità.

- Capacità di turni di lavoro (06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00).

- Conoscenze di flusso di tedesco, inglese a vantaggio

- Esperienza con Microsoft Word ed Excel.

Informazioni aggiuntive: Questa descrizione del lavoro non include tutte le attività e le responsabilità necessarie per questa funzione. Eventuali ulteriori compiti, compiti o responsabilità richiesti dal capo del team o dal gestore devono essere eseguiti di conseguenza.

Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti!

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job description

Position summary: The Senior Quality Control Technician (m/f/d) ensures compliance with the highest quality standards in the pharmaceutical production environment. This position covers a variety of tasks related to the inspection, monitoring and documentation of processes and materials and ensures compliance with GMP standards.

Main responsibilities:

- Start-up Release: Preparation of space, machines and materials before the start of production.

- In-process controls: carrying out regular in-process controls to ensure compliance.

- Final controls: conduct final inspections of packaged study medication (blind control).

- Quality decisions: making quality decisions in the respective work areas / cabins.

- Prevention of deviations: Implementation of measures to avoid process deviations.

- Deviation Management: Initiating Deviation Reports in Global Trackwise.

- Microbiological monitoring: performing microbiological measurements to ensure a sterile environment.

- Material management: managing the quarantine and release of materials in the operation.

- Inspection tours: conduct weekly inspection tours in the production areas.

- Machinery monitoring: support and implementation of equipment monitoring and calibration.

- Documentation: Creation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms in the electronic document management system (eDMS).

- Environmental monitoring: Review of weekly and monthly temperature and humidity readings.

- Light measurements: conduct light measurements as required.

- Support requests: Processing and support for internal and customer requests.

- Logbook management: controls and archiving of logbooks.

- Reporting problems: information direct supervisors about all problems that have occurred.

- Training needs: identifying personal training needs and supporting the training of new employees in the workplace.

Qualifications:

- Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing and/or quality control.

- Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).

- High degree of accuracy and efficiency.

- Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

- Ability to work shifts (06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00).

- Flowing knowledge of German, English to the advantage

- Experience with Microsoft Word and Excel.

Additional information: This job description does not include all the tasks and responsibilities required for this function. Any additional duties, tasks or responsibilities required by the team leader or manager must be performed accordingly.

## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

Positionsübersicht: Der Senior Quality Control Technician (m/w/d) sorgt für die Einhaltung höchster Qualitätsstandards in der pharmazeutischen Produktionsumgebung. Diese Position umfasst eine Vielzahl von Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit der Inspektion, Überwachung und Dokumentation von Prozessen und Materialien und gewährleistet die Einhaltung der GMP-Standards.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

- Start-Up Freigabe: Vorbereitung von Raum, Maschinen und Materialien vor dem Produktionsstart.

- In-Prozess-Kontrollen: Durchführung von regelmässigen In-Prozess-Kontrollen, um die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu gewährleisten.

- Endkontrollen: Durchführung von Abschlussinspektionen der verpackten Studienmedikation (Blindkontrolle).

- Qualitätsentscheidungen: Treffen von Qualitätsentscheidungen in den jeweiligen Arbeitsbereichen/Kabinen.

- Vorbeugung von Abweichungen: Implementierung von Massnahmen zur Vermeidung von Prozessabweichungen.

- Abweichungsmanagement: Initiieren von Abweichungsberichten in Global Trackwise.

- Mikrobiologische Überwachung: Durchführung von mikrobiologischen Messungen, um eine sterile Umgebung zu gewährleisten.

- Materialverwaltung: Verwalten der Quarantäne und Freigabe von Materialien im Betrieb.

- Inspektionsrundgänge: Führung von wöchentlichen Inspektionsgängen in den Produktionsbereichen durch.

- Überwachung der Maschinen: Unterstützung und Durchführung der Geräteüberwachung und -kalibrierung.

- Dokumentation: Erstellung von Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) und Formularen im elektronischen Dokumentenmanagementsystem (eDMS).

- Environmental-Monitoring: Überprüfung von wöchentlichen und monatlichen Temperatur- und Luftfeuchtigkeitsmesswerte.

- Lichtmessungen: Führung nach Bedarf Lichtmessungen durch.

- Support-Anfragen: Bearbeitung und Unterstützung bei Internen- und Kundenanfragen.

- Logbuch-Verwaltung: Kontrollen und Archivierung von Logbüchern.

- Meldung von Problemen: Informationen direkten Vorgesetzten über alle aufgetretenen Probleme.

- Schulungsbedarf: Ermittlung des persönlichen Schulungsbedarfs und Unterstützung der Schulung neuer Mitarbeiter am Arbeitsplatz.

Qualifikationen:

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Question - Could you be the right addition to our organization? **Location/Division Specific Information** **We are the Clinical Trials Division (CTD): We Supply the Hope that Changes Lives - Global (remote)** CTD partners with pharmaceutical and biotech customers around the world to ensure the right patients get the right therapies in the right doses at the right time - a concept that we internally adopt as "There is a Patient Waiting." Our unique blend of services includes project management, packaging, distribution, transportation management and specialty logistics, ancillary supply management, clinical supply optimization, bio-repository storage and much more. Our more than 4000 employees in over 15 countries work hard every day knowing that what they do matters. **A Day in the Life:** Design, Implement, Interpret and Review inventory management plan to forecast supply plan of study drugs to global clinical trials, using sound supply chain techniques. Provide input into User Requirement Specifications of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) medication management module and complete User Acceptance Testing if required. Review IRT strategy to ensure it supports the strategic supply plans and that IRT settings are adjusted to optimize the supply and demand.

Ensures plans are robust and optimizes global and regional supply strategies to ensure continuity of subject supply in the most effective and efficient manner. Develop and provide clients with reports on actual project spend versus budget. Establishes connections between demand planning team and S&OP ensuring the latest forecast information is aggregated and integrated into the divisional S&OP process. Partners with the Enterprise Project Manager, along with global and site project management teams and/or directly with the customer to proactively share key client data to facilitate an effective supply chain planning cycle. Ensure temperature excursion process is performed as required. Establish and maintain financial forecasts and monthly billing processes for assigned client projects. Assist in training and on boarding of new employees (buddy concept) Stay on top of relevant cGMPs, GCPs, and other regulatory requirements and ensure study management activities are aligned. Demonstrate and promote company vision. Conduct activities in a safe and efficient manner. **As Demonstrated By:** **Project Management** Structures demand plans in line with client strategy —starting from an identified need, sets objectives and specific goals. Speaks and writes in a clear, concise, and organized way. Listens carefully to others to ensure understanding and effective communication. **Technical Knowledge** Independently digests data that is applicable to project results and collaborators. Handles the demand planning part of projects efficiently in different systems and maintains their own as well as the team’s accountability for using Thermo Fisher tools to help the team be successful. Demonstrates technical proficiency and uses innovations to advance the efficiency and effectiveness of work processes, procedures, and outputs.

Knowledge of general inventory and billing principles, good documentation practices, and report generation. **Project Management Leadership** Works with colleagues to quickly resolve or raise solutions to problems. Develops a sense of urgency among cross-functional teams to influence project timelines. Communicates at the proper time, understands boundaries, respects differences, and confronts tension. Ensures that all communications are clear, focused, and based on a solid understanding of needs, using the most appropriate medium. Understanding of clinical supply requirements, phases of clinical development, and the factors that influence study designs preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** Requires strong eye for business including the ability to understand the manufacturing process and how cost impacts the overall business. Fornire l'ingresso in Specifiche di richiesta dell'utente del modulo di gestione del farmaco di risposta interattiva (IRT) e test di accettazione completa dell'utente, se necessario. Rivedere la strategia IRT per garantire che supporta i piani di approvvigionamento strategico e che le impostazioni IRT siano regolate per ottimizzare l'offerta e la domanda.

Assicura che i piani siano robusti e ottimizza le strategie di approvvigionamento globali e regionali per garantire la continuità dell'offerta di soggetti nel modo più efficace ed efficiente. Sviluppare e fornire ai clienti rapporti sulla spesa reale del progetto rispetto al budget. Stabilisce connessioni tra team di pianificazione della domanda e S&OP assicurando che le ultime informazioni di previsione siano aggregate e integrate nel processo divisionale S&OP. Partner con Enterprise Project Manager, insieme a team di gestione del progetto globali e del sito e/o direttamente con il cliente per condividere proattivamente i dati dei clienti chiave per facilitare un ciclo di pianificazione della supply chain efficace. Assicurare che il processo di escursione della temperatura sia eseguito come richiesto. Stabilire e mantenere previsioni finanziarie e processi di fatturazione mensile per progetti client assegnati. Assistere alla formazione e all'imbarco di nuovi dipendenti (concettuale di spesa) Rimanere in cima ai cGMP rilevanti, GCP e altri requisiti normativi e garantire attività di gestione dello studio sono allineati. Dimostrare e promuovere la visione aziendale. Condurre attività in modo sicuro ed efficiente. **Come dimostrato da: Project Management** Le strutture richiedono piani in linea con la strategia del cliente — a partire da una necessità identificata, fissa obiettivi e obiettivi specifici. Parla e scrive in modo chiaro, conciso e organizzato. Ascolta attentamente gli altri per garantire la comprensione e la comunicazione efficace. **La conoscenza tecnica ** Digerisce in modo indipendente i dati applicabili ai risultati del progetto e ai collaboratori. Mantiene la parte di pianificazione della domanda di progetti in modo efficiente in diversi sistemi e mantiene la propria, nonché la responsabilità del team per l'utilizzo di Thermo Gli strumenti di pesca per aiutare la squadra ad avere successo. Dimostra la competenza tecnica e utilizza innovazioni per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia dei processi di lavoro, delle procedure e degli output.

Conoscenza dei principi generali di inventario e fatturazione, buone pratiche di documentazione e la generazione di report. **Project Management Leadership ** Lavora con i colleghi per risolvere rapidamente o sollevare soluzioni ai problemi. Sviluppa un senso di urgenza tra i team interfunzionali per influenzare i tempi del progetto. Comunica al momento giusto, comprende i confini, rispetta le differenze e affronta la tensione. Assicura che tutte le comunicazioni siano chiare, focalizzate e basate su una solida comprensione delle esigenze, utilizzando il mezzo più appropriato. Per sostenere un senso di appartenenza e connessione, i dipendenti remoti sono tenuti a tenere la loro fotocamera e partecipare a videochiamate sia internamente che esternamente, come appropriato. **Keys to Success: Educazione ** Corso di laurea in supply chain, business / gestione operazioni preferito. diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente richiesto. ** Esperienza** da 4 a 5 anni di supply chain e/o esperienza di pianificazione leader globale nella progettazione e gestione della logistica della supply chain, preferibilmente in relazione alla progettazione e all'esecuzione di programmi clinici. Comprensione dei requisiti di approvvigionamento clinico, delle fasi di sviluppo clinico e dei fattori che influenzano i progetti di studio preferiti. ♪Knowledge, Skills, Abilities ♪ Richiede un occhio forte per il business, compresa la capacità di capire il processo di produzione e come i costi influiscono sul business complessivo. Richiede conoscenze e competenze PC avanzate utilizzando prodotti Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint). Richiede competenze sociali interpersonali e la capacità di guidare e lavorare in team tra cui servizi client, tecnici, pianificazione e competenze finanziarie.

Richiede eccellenti capacità analitiche e interpersonali. Certificazione APICS o preferenza equivalente

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

This is an outstanding chance for a committed and ambitious professional to join our project management team at Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. The Senior Project Manager, Client Services Distribution leads all aspects of leadership and is responsible for the actions of project managers and project support associates. You will work closely to guarantee the timely and flawless delivery of clinical supplies projects and successfully implement processes to improve efficiency. While you will not coordinate day-to-day project activities, you will lead all aspects of your team's client portfolio, ensuring outstanding client happiness and consistent business delivery.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, mentor, and conduct yearly evaluations for Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Support Associates. Put into effect Performance Improvement Plans when needed.
- Establish goals for direct reports in alignment with company initiatives and vision.

- Identify, develop, and implement process improvements to improve overall efficiency and productivity.
- Address all personnel issues, timecard maintenance, and job descriptions for support associates.
- Participate in sales and marketing activities, including customer kickoffs, teleconferences, customer visits, audits, estimates, and quotations.
- Initiate and maintain continuous communication with appropriate departments.
- Provide regular training, including system and SOP training.
- Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices in all areas of responsibility.
- Demonstrate and promote the company vision and values.

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Accredited degree, preferably in a health-related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 5-7 years of experience supporting project management teams.
- Previous work experience in the Healthcare field required.
- 2 years of management experience.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent relationship building.
- Proven experience managing teams and working with customers in dynamic environments.
- In-depth understanding of clinical trials and business services.
- Proficient in using company SOPs and Quality standards.
- Excellent organizational, planning, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong customer management skills; proactive in anticipating and responding to client needs.
- Experience with both detailed execution and strategic orientation.

- Drives Growth
- Builds Customer Allegiance
- Communicates Openly
- Builds Organizational Relationships
- Adapts to Process Improvement Environments

## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

When you’re part of the team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do important work, helping customers in finding cures for cancer, protecting the environment, and making sure our food is safe. Your work will have a real-world impact, and you’ll be supported in achieving your career goals.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is a world-class company serving the scientific community and healthcare industry. We are leaders in providing clinical supply chain management services and clinical supplies distributed to patients worldwide.

## Position Summary

The Team Leader – In-Process Inspection (IPI) is responsible for leading and coordinating daily inspection activities within the Press Manufacturing environment.

This role ensures compliance with quality standards, GMP requirements, customer specifications, and operational objectives while supporting team performance, employee development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Team Leader acts as a key interface between shop floor operations, Quality, Production, Engineering, and Management to ensure timely delivery of high-quality manufactured products.

This position reports directly to the Press Manufacturing Manager.

## Your Responsibilities

## 1. Operations & Inspection Management

- Ensure smooth daily IPI operations within Press Manufacturing
- Coordinate inspection activities across multiple operational areas, including flexographic and digital press production + folding machines
- Monitor daily production schedules and proactively address operational constraints or delays
- Ensure timely completion of inspection activities aligned with manufacturing priorities
- Support inspection execution when operationally required
- Provide visibility on inspection status and operational priorities to management
- Ensure effective shift handover and continuity between teams
- Support manufacturing coverage planning, including overtime coordination when needed

## 2. Team Management

- Lead, supervise, and support IPI inspectors in daily operations
- Maintain strong shop floor presence and accessibility
- Ensure inspectors comply with established inspection standards and procedures
- Monitor employee performance and support achievement of departmental goals and KPIs
- Provide regular performance feedback and contribute to PMD processes
- Support employee engagement, accountability, and team development
- Promote a positive and collaborative team environment
- Support conflict resolution and day-to-day team management activities

## 3. Training & People Development

- Ensure onboarding and proper integration of new employees
- Ensure all inspectors are appropriately trained and qualified for their activities
- Evaluate employee competency and maintain training compliance
- Support continuous learning and development opportunities
- Promote team versatility and operational flexibility
- Establish and support annual development objectives for team members

## 4. Quality, Safety & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, WIs, Master Forms, customer protocols, and cGMP requirements
- Maintain a safe and compliant working environment
- Promote a strong quality culture within the department
- Support investigations related to:

  - Deviations
  - Quality events
  - Audit observations

- Ensure accurate completion and review of departmental documentation and checklists

  - Label Design
  - Planning / Administration
  - IT
  - Other operational departments
- Work closely with Press Manufacturing leadership to ensure production priorities are achieved

- Participate in daily operational meetings and escalation discussions

- Identify operational inefficiencies and support implementation of corrective actions

- Monitor and report departmental metrics and operational KPIs
- Maintain accurate area data collection and reporting

- Deviazioni

- Garanzia di qualità
- Progettazione di etichette
- Pianificazione / Amministrazione
- IT

- Comunicare efficacemente con i fornitori per quanto riguarda i miglioramenti o le questioni delle apparecchiature di ispezione automatizzate
- Fornire risposte tempestive agli stakeholder interni ed esterni quando si presentano problemi operativi
